title: Admin loading fix published to GitHub and deployed to lecomax.com
summary: The tested admin update is live on both L’ecomax domains and pushed to the GitHub fix branch with draft PR 53. Vercel checks and public follow-up passed.

changes.detail: Publish current-report-first Analytics loading, compact comparison totals, request deadlines, obsolete-period cancellation and retry after failed main requests. Delay and reduce repeated admin navigation badge reads.

Push fix/admin-loading-20261013 to lecomaxstore-prog/lecomax with code commit b49b35a and archive commit 2c46ea2; create draft PR https://github.com/lecomaxstore-prog/lecomax/pull/53. Retain previous source reports and append/check tooling.

Promote Ready Vercel deployment dpl_6mMrE2mLj1TVFBQL2WCTDqaAaQ7g. Vercel aliases confirm lecomax.com and www.lecomax.com target lecomax-mq3mrshnx-lecomaxstore-4321s-projects.vercel.app. First promotion failed with different-team scope; explicit lecomaxstore-4321s-projects scope succeeded. No permissions or account settings changed.

validation.name: Local and GitHub source validation
validation.detail: TypeScript passed in isolated release and clean GitHub checkout; 23 focused isolated regressions and five GitHub Analytics tests passed. Confirmed local production build exited 0 and generated 249 pages. Candidate Ready status verified with Vercel inspect.

validation.name: Candidate checks
validation.detail: Homepage and boutique HTTP 200 with expected content; products/settings HTTP 200 and nonempty arrays; anonymous Analytics summary and admin verification HTTP 401. Initial multi-parameter Analytics curl was split by Windows command parsing; corrected single-parameter check passed.

validation.name: Live public follow-up
validation.detail: 32 live HTTP checks passed for public pages, products/settings APIs, JavaScript/CSS assets, original and optimized hero images. One responsive hero and no hidden menu images asserted. Live anonymous Analytics summary and admin verification both HTTP 401. Single homepage observation: 1776ms response headers, 2043ms total; not a browser speed score or guaranteed improvement.

validation.name: Vercel diagnosis
validation.detail: Pre-rollout six-hour error and HTTP 5xx queries returned no records; post-rollout 15-minute error query returned no records. Official status page showed all systems operational; October 12 build/deploy incident resolved at 20:11 UTC. Available logs cannot rule out intermittent latency.

validation.name: Scope and retention
validation.detail: Production release changed exactly six source/test/documentation files from prior deployed source. GitHub fix based on current main, with archive and .vercelignore retention additions. Draft PR because main differs from current production in unrelated areas; no main merge or replacement of unrelated edits performed.

validation.name: Phone and authenticated browser acceptance
validation.detail: No connected browser session was available. Physical-phone rendering, authenticated Analytics timings, checkout/payment interactions and Core Web Vitals remain unmeasured. Existing 5000-row query limits and up-to-one-minute badge freshness remain.
